claims: Tattoo shops offer discounted small flash designs for $13, $20, or $31 on Friday the 13th.
Tattoo artists create flash sheets filled with small pre-designed flash art.
Common Friday the 13th tattoo designs feature the number 13.
Common Friday the 13th tattoo designs feature black cats.
Common Friday the 13th tattoo designs feature ghosts.
Common Friday the 13th tattoo designs feature skulls.
Friday the 13th tattoos are traditionally priced with a "13" theme.
Friday the 13th tattoos were popularized by tattooers like Oliver Peck in the 1990s/2000s.
Some artists operate on a 24-hour first-come-first-served basis for Friday the 13th tattoos
